patterns.text: Routes governed work across identity boundaries (ORG/USER) without breaking ownership
ORG and USER projections never collapse — each maintains its own governance scope
Galaxy visualization (web, iOS, Android) consumes scopes.json — no hardcoded galaxy data
Federation patterns: which org-user pairs produce the most WORK; which reach 255-bit compliance
COVERAGE.md source → generated: compiler emits from CANON axiom + validate bits, GOV trees carry no source COVERAGE
COVERAGE.md is a compiler output — fix compiler or contract, never hand-edit source COVERAGE
README.md boilerplate extinct: 18-line template → 3-line lean form (scope + axiom)
VOCAB redundant entries extinct: child scopes must not duplicate parent VOCAB
build-surfaces modularized: monolith (1797 lines) → 4 extracted modules (dashboard, discover, fleet, gc)
design-diff-gate shell wrapper extinct: Python-only CLI replaces shell+Python duplication
